summary: Prioritise AI investments, strengthen oversight, and track value with executive tools. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: AI training for senior executives helps business leaders and senior specialists prioritize investment proposals and oversee adoption across business functions. Participants learn to map use cases to business objectives, compare business cases and value measures, assign governance accountability, and review risks using AI RMF 1.0 and ISO/IEC 42001:2023. The course also covers workforce planning, executive reporting, and forecasting agentic AI costs.
audienceIntro: This course suits executives who make AI investment, oversight, and workforce decisions, along with senior specialists who prepare evidence for those decisions.
modules: AI Investment Cases and Value Measures
Recommendation of the Council on Artificial Intelligence
AI Operating Models and Workforce Change
Agentic AI Costs and Scaling Decisions
AI Executive Dashboards and Board Papers
prerequisites: Prior experience in a senior business, technology, data, finance, risk, security, or workforce leadership role is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Advanced topics such as agentic AI cost forecasting are addressed at conceptual and operational decision-making level, not technical engineering level.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
